meta.gain: Loss reduction inside the LightGBM component's trees ONLY (0.6 of the blend); not a measure of the ensemble. Per-model gain: gain_by_model.
meta.permutation: Increase in hold-out RMSLE when the feature is shuffled, measured on the ENSEMBLE prediction (backtest ensemble, hold-out window).
meta.shap: APPROXIMATE ensemble view: mean absolute TreeSHAP contribution of each model (log / log1p scale), averaged with the blend weights (0.6 / 0.1 / 0.3). Each model's own list is exact: shap_by_model.
